refresh.note: GitHub caps __Type.fields at 2 per query; run the three queries below
refresh.trimmed: IssueComment and PullRequestReviewThread are trimmed to the fields dispositionMutation selects. Every other type below is the FULL field list as introspected, NON_NULL and LIST wrappers unwrapped — a leaf reads as the named type it wraps (String, ID, URI, Boolean).
queries: gh api graphql -f query='{ A: __type(name:"Mutation"){ fields { name type { name kind ofType { name } } } } B: __type(name:"ResolveReviewThreadPayload"){ fields { name type { name kind ofType { name } } } } }'

gh api graphql -f query='{ A: __type(name:"AddCommentPayload"){ fields { name type { name kind ofType { name } } } } B: __type(name:"IssueCommentEdge"){ fields { name type { name kind ofType { name } } } } }'

gh api graphql -f query='{ A: __type(name:"IssueComment"){ fields { name type { name kind ofType { name } } } } B: __type(name:"PullRequestReviewThread"){ fields { name type { name kind ofType { name } } } } }'
